mechanismOfAction.summary: N1-Boc thermolabile prodrug of 5-MeO-DALT; inactive until pyrolysis (~150–200°C) or acid conditions cleave the Boc group, releasing the 5-HT1A/2A agonist 5-MeO-DALT.
mechanismOfAction.description: 'NB-' prefix denotes N1-tert-butoxycarbonyl (NOT N-benzyl as sometimes assumed). Boc group cleaves at high temperature (pyrolysis/smoking route) or under acid conditions. Parent 5-MeO-DALT: 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A agonist with rapid onset and short duration. Delivered parent dose from the Boc compound is unpredictable. No validated dosing for the Boc form itself.
